run_preprocess_wikinews: run the script to preprocess WikiNews pickle data into KILT-format JSONL files for multiple languages
create_kilt_dataset_from_wikinews: create a KILT-format dataset from pickled WikiNews data by extracting anchors with single Wikidata IDs and their surrounding context
split_kilt_dataset: split a WikiNews KILT dataset into train, dev, and test JSONL files using an 80/10/10 random split
extract_anchor_context: extract left context, mention, and right context for each anchor in WikiNews documents to build input-output pairs
convert_wikinews_to_jsonl: convert multi-language WikiNews pickle files into JSONL format with optional train/dev/test splits for entity linking tasks
